records.subject: Welcome aboard, Harbor Media
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Harbor Media* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Active pro account reached first_project day 2 and sent an invite (slack:10421ae2), and Victor replied positively with no blockers (email:d8ca8c4b). No tickets, 8 days left in window. Engaged but key_milestone still unreached after 6 days, so slightly above even odds.

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Glad to hear things are going well, and that the layout is starting to click. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so adding a few tasks to your project is usually where it starts to feel useful, especially now that a teammate is on board.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your project with you and answer anything about the layout as we go.

Best,
Priya
